description.text: The first round of Pokémon TCG Gym promos, from the Present Pack given out in Malaysia and Singapore. Gym shops give these promos out as participation prizes, while stocks last. Each is an English card reprinted with the Pokémon TCG Gym stamp, keeping its original's number. This round reprints cards of the first Scarlet & Violet sets, such as Miraidon ex, Pidgeot ex, Baxcalibur, Mimikyu and the alternate-art Arven and Miriam, plus three Sword & Shield cards: Radiant Charizard, Radiant Greninja and Forest Seal Stone.
